member.remarks: Opens a socket at the Port specified at the Work Order service (not the CAD Service) to download the CAD file associated with the specified Work Order. When a Work Order CAD file is opened in Iris Client, the Work Order and CAD Services convert the original CAD file into an intermediary Standard ACIS Binary (.sab) file which is cached within the Work Order folder. This conversion can also be triggered with the `/TranslateCad` endpoint in CAD service. If this conversion has been performed, that .sab file will be the one provided. If not, the original CAD file - in its original format - will be provided.
